name: Kajiwara Kagetoki
source:
Kajiwara no Kagetoki is a general on the Kamakura Genji side who was a vassal of Yoritomo. He was originally a follower of a man named Oba Kagechika on the side of the Heike clan.

In the Battle of Ishibashiyama, the enemy Yoritomo has scattered. When he found Yoritomo on the run, he promised to make Yoritomo his retainer. He also betrayed the Heike clan and helped Yoritomo escape. Although he saved Yoritomo's life, he was a man with a peculiar character.

However, he has some conflicts with the earnest and straightforward Yoshitsune.
